title: Vincente de Santa
blurb: Captain Vincente de Santa (spelling 'Vincente'): RDR1 Act II, Mexican Army officer under Allende in Chuparosa; missions with John (decoy train in 'Civilization, at Any Price', etc.); betrays John in Chuparosa ('Cowards Die Many Times': Reyes's rebels save John); dies later at Sepulcro, shot by John or by the rebels (player's choice, see HOUSE_FACTS; Victor's line differs by branch). Actor per credits (verify). Undead Nightmare if any.
